title: MIXAT: Combining Continuous and Discrete Adversarial Training for LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial training and robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates whether models produce 'harmful' or 'unethical' content in response to attacks, it does so from a technical safety and robustness perspective rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks themselves.
